summary: Sheikh Ali Mashhour provides a detailed Tafseer (exegesis) of Surah Al-Anbiya, focusing on verses about righteous deeds and divine recording of actions. He explains that sincere efforts in worship are guaranteed by Allah, contrasting worldly efforts which may or may not succeed. The Sheikh discusses how Allah records all deeds through commissioned angels, referencing the preserved tablet (Lawh al-Mahfuz) written 50,000 years before creation. A significant portion addresses the Islamic middle-ground position on destiny (Qadr) and free will, refuting both extreme determinism and absolute free will philosophies, while critiquing Darwinian evolution as lacking scientific rigor and its logical implications for human dignity.
